title: Speech and Language Therapist, SEND School
summary: Assess and support pupils with autism, learning difficulties and communication needs at a specialist SEND school.
body:
## The position

Bright Futures is working with a specialist SEND school to recruit a passionate speech and language therapist to join a supportive multidisciplinary team. It's a fantastic opportunity for a therapist committed to helping children and young people with communication needs reach their full potential in a nurturing, structured environment.

You'll work closely with teachers, teaching assistants and other professionals, assessing pupils, delivering targeted interventions and helping staff use effective communication strategies across the curriculum.

## About the pupils

The school supports children and young people with a range of needs, including:

- Autism spectrum condition (ASC)
- Moderate to severe learning difficulties
- Speech, language and communication needs
- Social, emotional and developmental needs

## The role

- Assess pupils' speech, language and communication needs.
- Plan and deliver individual and group therapy programmes.
- Monitor progress and adapt interventions to meet pupil needs.
- Contribute to EHCP assessments, reports and annual reviews.
- Give advice and strategies to teachers and support staff.
- Work collaboratively with families and external professionals.
- Keep accurate clinical notes and reports.

## What you'll need

- A degree in Speech and Language Therapy.
- HCPC registration (or eligibility).
- Experience supporting children or young people with SEND.
- Strong communication and report-writing skills.
- The ability to work well in a multidisciplinary team.

## What the school offers

- A welcoming and supportive team.
- Professional development and training.
- The chance to make a meaningful difference to pupils' lives.
- Collaborative working with education and therapy professionals.
